providersEmpty: Paseo has no Claude, Codex, or Antigravity provider.
providersOffNote: Agents of a provider that is turned off are never scheduled, and its pending reservations are canceled. Turning it back on does not restore them.
providerSettingsErrorTitle: Provider settings could not be read
providerSettingsResetHint: Turns every Claude, Codex, and Antigravity provider back on.
queueHowToAdd: Open an agent and tap “Follow-up queue” next to its composer to add one.
queueHint: Only text follow-ups go here. After the limit recovers, the original task finishes first, then queued items run in the order they were added. Without a resume plan, tap “Resume” after saving. Auto Resume supports enabled Claude, Codex, and Antigravity subscription providers.
queueAddHint: Saved on the host and kept after this page closes.
queueAddHintAttempt: The save result was not confirmed. Retrying uses the same item and will not enqueue it twice.
queueRetryUncertainHint: Check the agent's record first; retrying may repeat work that already completed.
queueSkipUncertainHint: Once this item is confirmed done or no longer needed, continue with the later follow-ups.
queueResumeHint: First continue the original task, then run follow-ups in order; it will not interrupt a running task.
queuePauseHint: The running task keeps going; later items stay saved.
queueLoadErrorTitle: Could not read the follow-up queue
queueRemoveStale: This item already started running or was removed. Check the refreshed queue.
queueUpdateFailed: Could not update the queue. Try again.
queueReadFailed: Could not read the queue. Try again.
jobsEmptyBody: Agents stopped by a usage limit appear here.
toggleStale: This schedule already ran or changed.
editTooEarlyReset: Too early — the limit resets at {{reset}}. Earliest is {{earliest}}.
editChanged: This schedule already ran or changed.
reasonSaved: Saved. Tap “Resume” to continue the original task first, then send follow-ups in order.
reasonPausedByUser: Queue paused; the running turn will still finish.
reasonScheduleFailed: Could not schedule the continue. Check provider settings and try again.
reasonProviderModelChanged: The provider, model, or account changed. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonManualActivity: A manual send or another task was detected. Queue paused; check it, then resume.
reasonConversationChanged: A newer message or a settings change was detected. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonTurnChanged: The current turn changed. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonAutoResumeStopped: Auto-resume stopped retrying. Follow-ups are still saved; check them, then resume.
reasonOtherTurnEnded: Another turn ended. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonTurnNotOurs: Could not confirm the turn that just ended belonged to this queue. Check the session, then resume.
reasonCanceled: The current turn was canceled. Queue paused; check it, then resume.
reasonFailed: The current turn failed. Check the result, then retry or skip this item.
reasonContextChanged: The provider, model, or conversation changed. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonAutoResumeOff: Auto Resume is off or its settings could not be read. Queue paused.
reasonAccountChanged: The sign-in method or account changed. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonAgentChanged: The agent's status changed while checking quota. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonDeliveryUnknown: Could not confirm the message was delivered. The original text is still saved. Check the session, then retry or skip.
reasonPluginRestarted: The plugin restarted during execution. Follow-ups are still saved. Check the current task result, then resume.
reasonAgentGone: The agent was closed, archived, or its sign-in changed. Check the queue, then resume.
reasonProviderUnsupported: This provider no longer supports automatic continues. Queue paused.
reasonProviderOff: Automatic continue is off for this provider. Saved follow-ups are paused.
reasonContinueDeliveryUnknown: Could not confirm the continue message was delivered. Check the session, then resume the follow-up queue.
reasonResumeDeliveryUnknown: On restart the plugin could not confirm the continue message was delivered. Check the session, then resume the queue.
reasonAgentBusy: The agent is still running or was closed. Wait for the current turn to finish and reopen the session, then resume.
reasonAgentPending: The agent is waiting for a permission or input.
errorTextLength: Enter a follow-up message of 1 to 20,000 characters.
errorAgentUnavailable: This agent is unavailable or archived.
errorMaxMessages: This agent already has 100 follow-ups. Remove some first.
errorMessageRunning: This message is running. Stop the agent before removing it.
errorEmptyQueue: There are no queued messages to send.
errorUncertainDecision: The previous message may already have run. Choose “Retry this item” or “Skip this item” first.
errorProviderDisabled: Turn on Auto Resume for this subscription provider before resuming the queue.
errorNoQueue: This agent has no saved follow-up queue.
errorQueueStoreRead: Could not read the saved follow-up queue; existing messages were kept.
